## Checklist

- [ ] Have you checked the changes at all screensizes? Mobile, tablet, desktop & reasonable zoom levels.
- [ ] Have you checked the changes in both light and dark mode?
- [ ] Have you checked the changes when the user's wallet is connected / disconnected?
- [ ] Have you checked how the changes are effected by different feature flag variations, and removed any redundent feature flags?
- [ ] Is all new JSX semantic?
- [ ] Are micro-animations running smoothly? Any edge cases?
- [ ] Have you removed any redundent code, console.logs, or comments?
- [ ] Have you avoided code duplication and abstracted where possible?
- [ ] Does new code use index.css variables where applicable, and rem rather than px values?
- [ ] Have you added tests where needed?
- [ ] Have you modified a global component? If so, have you check the other locations it is used for any unexpected bugs?
- [ ] Have you tested any new interactions on a touch screen?
- [ ] Have you checked the browser console for any new errors?
